hairstyle.name: Natural afro
hairstyle.summary: A full natural Afro that lets dense curls or coils expand outward into a broad rounded silhouette while preserving visible texture and a softer, less geometrically controlled perimeter.

candidates.description: Natural afro interpretation for straight hair at short length, with full scalp coverage. Keep a softly rounded silhouette, visible texture, and a natural rather than geometric perimeter.

factors.rationale: Straight texture does not naturally create the defining curl or coil volume.
Short length can form a compact Afro but limits its volume.
Full coverage supports a continuous rounded outline.
